days.defaultWordMeaning: all keyboard typing, including correction retyping and rewrite typing; command-inserted seed strings excluded
days.method: nonnegative quadratic by category, fixed measured day-0 intercept, last three checkpoints; sample-day axis scaled by total typing volume including corrections and rewrites
days.limitation: word volume and elapsed days are confounded; the fit does not validate full-volume capacity or late mark/removal behavior
